en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from his brother Al Hassan, from Zurara Bin Muhammad, from Sama’at,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineenasws judged regarding the one who murdered, and drank wine, and stole, so heasws established the Penalty (Hadd) upon him. So heasws whipped him due to his drinking the wine, and cut his hand regarding his theft, and killed him due to his comitting murder’.
